title: Comment Command Block
description: Commad Block Hover Note‌ in Java Edition
body:
# Comment Command Block

### NEEDS [bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-suite) TO RUN
(or [bookshelf-view](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-view#download))

This datapack can display the command block's custom name (CustomName) \
as hover note above the command block when targeting it.\
In this state, "\_" represents "needs redstone".\
Sneak while targeting the command block to display its execution result.\
In this state, "\_" indicates the previous command failed to execute.

You can change its custom name using a writable book.\
In creative mode write inside the first page of writable book,\
Then target at command block and throw it (default being "Q"),\
will modify the custom name to the first page of the writable book.\
If you press shift while throwing, instead of editing the command block\
will modify the writable book's first page into the command block's custom name

---

### 依赖 [bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-suite) 运行
(或者 [bookshelf-view](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bookshelf-view#download))

这个数据包可以在对准命令方块时将命令方块的自定义名称(CustomName)作为悬浮文本展示在命令方块上方\
这种状态下"\_"代表红石控制\
潜行对准命令方块就可以显示其运行结果, 这种状态下"\_"代表上一条命令执行失败

此数据包使你可以通过书与笔更改和读取命令方块的自定义名称\
在创造模式下向命令方块丢出书与笔(默认按键为Q), 会将命令方块的自定义名称更改为书与笔的第一页\
如果丢出的同时潜行, 那么书与笔的第一页将会被更改成命令方块的自定义名称
